data.name: Zackariah
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Zackariah means 'God remembers.' This name appears in the Old Testament, belonging to a priest who received a message from God through an angel. His wife Elizabeth was barren, and upon their son John the Baptist's birth, they named him 'John' because of God's remembrance and fulfillment of their long-awaited promise.
data.spiritual_meaning: Remembrance and fulfillment of God's promises

It serves as a testament to His promise to remember and fulfill His covenant, even when it seems as though the wait may be long and arduous. In moments when we feel forgotten or unheard, the name Zackariah serves as a source of inspiration and encouragement, inviting us to trust in God's unwavering love and commitment.
